message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test and build

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@692973e3d937129bcbf40652eb9f2f61becf3332 # v4.1.7

    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: .gradle
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

    - name: Build Docker image for building
      run: docker build -f DockerfileForBuild -t plantuml-service-builder .

    - name: Run tests
      run: docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/app/.gradle plantuml-service-builder ./gradlew test

    - name: Run build
      run: docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/app/.gradle plantuml-service-builder ./gradlew stage

    - name: Check build artifacts
      run: |
        if [ ! -f "./bin/plantuml-service.jar" ]; then
          echo "Build failed: JAR file not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Build successful: JAR file created"
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs Gradle (test and stage) inside Docker on every pull request with GRADLE_USER_HOME pointing at the workspace .gradle directory, so dependencies are re-fetched on each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache pattern is supported by measured evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, measured_ci_workflow_on_fork, 20.4% elapsed reduction with all checks passing) and matches the preconditions: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs can be keyed on the Gradle manifest files. Adding an actions/cache step for the workspace .gradle directory, keyed on runner OS plus hashFiles of **/*.gradle* and gradle-wrapper.properties, reuses downloaded dependencies across runs while preserving every existing build and test step and required check. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or deployment/publishing actions are added, and no new network targets beyond the standard Actions cache service are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
